== Usage ==
Standard header/category marker for Field Procedure articles. Procedure listings are registered through [[Module:Procedures]] and the relevant data module rather than repeated manually on every index page.

The template marks the page's content type as <code>Field Procedures</code>. The primary topic is normally resolved from structured procedure metadata. Use <code>topic=</code> only for a procedure that is not yet represented in the central procedure data.
